label: Nothing: it passes
title: A page built from the vocabulary
why: A heading, a layout class and one primary button from the catalogue. Nothing here is styled by hand, so there is nothing to find.

label: A gradient and an emoji
title: Decorating a button by hand
why: The most recognised marks of a generated interface: an inline purple gradient and an emoji standing in for an icon.

label: Hand-written CSS values
title: A stylesheet with its own colours and sizes
why: A colour, a padding, a radius, a shadow, a font and a type size, each a little off the scales. This is how screens drift apart a pixel at a time.

label: Three primary buttons
title: Every action made the main one
why: Emphasis works only when one thing has it. A view has one primary action.

label: Three identical cards
title: The feature-card template
why: A row of same-shaped cards is a template, not a design for the content. Uniform items belong in a list or a table.

label: Invented class names
title: Guessing a class, and reaching for utilities
why: A modifier the catalogue does not have, and colour, radius and shadow utilities on a screen. The finding suggests the nearest real class.

label: A hidden critical action
title: Delete, only inside a closed disclosure
why: An action marked critical must be reachable without opening anything. This one is found only by a reader who thinks to look.
